designationHistory.indexText: Fish and Wildlife Service records give December 21, 1948 as the establishment date of Silver Lake National Wildlife Refuge, a limited-interest (easement) refuge, under the Act of August 14, 1946, the forerunner of the Fish and Wildlife Coordination Act.

authority.citation: Act of August 14, 1946 (Fish and Wildlife Coordination Act amendments), 16 U.S.C. 661-667e

sources.name: FWS, Comprehensive Conservation Plan: North Dakota Limited-interest National Wildlife Refuges (2006), Table 4

review.by: Accepted on the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service's own record (Library decision)
